notes.title: Small patch for February 7, 2023
notes.content:
Side Scape Version 1.4

	- Fixed an issue that caused Allegair to start attacking during dialogue.
	- Fixed various issues with the Phase Rune item.
	- Fixed an audio issue that caused some sounds to be too loud.
	- Fixed an issue that caused the game to slow down during the Frozen Ship boss fight.
	- Fixed an issue with the Spirit Bottle that could cause Sir Knight to become stuck.

notes.title: Patch for February 3 2023
notes.content:
Side Scape Version 1.3.2

	- Fixed a crash bug that occurred when when using the Stasis Beam against certain enemies.
	- Fixed various audio issues.

notes.title: Hotfix for February 1 2023
notes.content: Fixed a glitch that allowed Captain Grisham to jump in midair immediately after switching from Sir Knight.

notes.title: Update for February 1 2023
notes.content:
Side Scape Version 1.3

	- The game can now be played in windowed mode. (It will be windowed by default and can be changed in settings.)
	- Fixed an issue that occurred when using the "Up Jumps" control scheme that caused the game to display the wrong control prompt.

notes.title: Update for January 31 2023
notes.content:
Side Scape Version 1.2

	- Fixed an issue where worm-like enemies could become stuck in walls.
	- Fixed an issue where the inventory button could sometimes not be remapped to a new button.
	- Fixed an issue with the dialogue initiation in the Quarantine Camp in the graveyard.
	- Fixed an issue where certain sound effects were unaffected by changing the volume of sounds in settings.
	- Various graphical improvements.
